text_en: There was a long war between the house of Saul and the house of David; David grew stronger and stronger, while the house of Saul became weaker and weaker.
text_cn: 撒乌耳家与达味家间的战争相持很久；但达味家逐渐强盛，撒乌耳家却日趋衰弱。

text_en: Sons were born to David at Hebron: his firstborn was Amnon, of Ahinoam of Jezreel;
text_cn: 达味在赫贝龙生的儿子：长子阿默农，是依次勒耳人阿希诺罕所生；

text_en: his second, Chileab, of Abigail the widow of Nabal of Carmel; the third, Absalom son of Maacah, daughter of King Talmai of Geshur;
text_cn: 次子基肋阿布，是曾作加尔默耳人纳巴耳妻子的阿彼盖耳所生；三子是阿贝沙隆，是革叔尔王塔耳买的女儿玛阿加所生；

text_en: the fourth, Adonijah son of Haggith; the fifth, Shephatiah son of Abital;
text_cn: 四子阿多尼雅，是哈基特所生；五子舍法提雅，是阿彼塔耳所生；

text_en: and the sixth, Ithream, of David’s wife Eglah. These were born to David in Hebron.
text_cn: 六子依特兰是达味妻子厄革拉所生：以上是达味在赫贝龙所生的儿子。

text_en: While there was war between the house of Saul and the house of David, Abner was making himself strong in the house of Saul.
text_cn: 撒乌耳家同达味家战争期间，阿贝乃尔获得操纵撒乌耳家的权柄。

text_en: Now Saul had a concubine whose name was Rizpah daughter of Aiah. And Ishbaal said to Abner, “Why have you gone in to my father’s concubine? ”
text_cn: 撒乌耳有一妾名叫黎兹帕，是阿雅的女儿，阿贝乃尔娶了她；依市巴耳对阿贝乃尔说：“你为什么亲近我父亲的妾？”

text_en: The words of Ishbaal made Abner very angry; he said, “Am I a dog’s head for Judah? Today I keep showing loyalty to the house of your father Saul, to his brothers, and to his friends, and have not given you into the hand of David; and yet you charge me now with a crime concerning this woman.
text_cn: 为了依市巴耳这句话，阿贝乃尔勃然大怒说：“莫非我是犹大的狗头？直到今天我怜恤你父亲撒乌耳，和他的兄弟以及他的朋友，没有使你落在达味手里；你今天竟为了一个女人挑我的错！

text_en: So may God do to Abner and so may he add to it! For just what the Lord has sworn to David, that will I accomplish for him,
text_cn: 若我今后不依照上主对达味所誓许的去行：

text_en: to transfer the kingdom from the house of Saul, and set up the throne of David over Israel and over Judah, from Dan to Beer-sheba. ”
text_cn: 废除撒乌耳家的王位，建立达味的宝座，使他由丹直到贝尔舍巴，统治全以色列和犹大，愿天主如此，并加倍地惩罚我！”

text_en: And Ishbaal could not answer Abner another word, because he feared him.
text_cn: 依市巴耳因为怕阿贝乃尔，连一句话也不敢回答。

text_en: Abner sent messengers to David at Hebron, saying, “To whom does the land belong? Make your covenant with me, and I will give you my support to bring all Israel over to you. ”
text_cn: 阿贝乃尔立即派使者到赫贝龙见达味说：“这地是谁的？”是说：“只要你与我订立盟约，我必伸手援助你，使全以色列都归顺你。”

text_en: He said, “Good; I will make a covenant with you. But one thing I require of you: you shall never appear in my presence unless you bring Saul’s daughter Michal when you come to see me. ”
text_cn: 达味答说：“好！我愿与你订立盟约，但是，我要求你一个条件：就是你来见我时，若不把撒乌耳的女儿米加耳带来，你休想见我。”

text_en: Then David sent messengers to Saul’s son Ishbaal, saying, “Give me my wife Michal, to whom I became engaged at the price of one hundred foreskins of the Philistines. ”
text_cn: 随后，达味就派使者到撒乌耳的儿子依市巴耳那里说：“请把我的妻米加耳归还给我，她是我以一百培肋舍特人的包皮聘定的。”

text_en: Ishbaal sent and took her from her husband Paltiel the son of Laish.
text_cn: 依市巴耳就派人，从拉依士的儿子帕耳提耳，她丈夫那里把她带来。

text_en: But her husband went with her, weeping as he walked behind her all the way to Bahurim. Then Abner said to him, “Go back home! ” So he went back.
text_cn: 她的丈夫与她同行，一边走一边哭，送她到了巴胡陵。阿贝乃尔向他说：“你回去吧！”他就回去了。

text_en: Abner sent word to the elders of Israel, saying, “For some time past you have been seeking David as king over you.
text_cn: 阿贝乃尔同以色列的长老商议说：“你们早已渴望达味作你们的君王。

text_en: Now then bring it about; for the Lord has promised David: Through my servant David I will save my people Israel from the hand of the Philistines, and from all their enemies. ”
text_cn: 现在你们就进行吧！因为上主曾论及达味说：我要藉我的仆人达味，从培肋舍特人以及一切仇敌手中，拯救我的百姓以色列。”

text_en: Abner also spoke directly to the Benjaminites; then Abner went to tell David at Hebron all that Israel and the whole house of Benjamin were ready to do.
text_cn: 阿贝乃尔也游说了本雅明人；以后阿贝乃尔去赫贝龙见达味，向他报告以色列和本雅明全家共同赞成的事。

text_en: When Abner came with twenty men to David at Hebron, David made a feast for Abner and the men who were with him.
text_cn: 阿贝乃尔遂率领二十人去赫贝龙见达味。达味设宴款待了阿贝乃尔和他的随员。

text_en: Abner said to David, “Let me go and rally all Israel to my lord the king, in order that they may make a covenant with you, and that you may reign over all that your heart desires. ” So David dismissed Abner, and he went away in peace.
text_cn: 阿贝乃尔向达味说：“我要动身去号召全以色列，来拥护我主大王，使他们与你立约：这样你能依照你的心愿来统治一切。”事后，达味放阿贝乃尔平安走了。

text_en: Just then the servants of David arrived with Joab from a raid, bringing much spoil with them. But Abner was not with David at Hebron, for David had dismissed him, and he had gone away in peace.
text_cn: 达味的臣仆和约阿布出征回来，带回了很多战利品。那时，阿贝乃尔已不在赫贝龙达味那里了，因为达味放他平安走了。

text_en: When Joab and all the army that was with him came, it was told Joab, “Abner son of Ner came to the king, and he has dismissed him, and he has gone away in peace. ”
text_cn: 约阿布和他率领的军队一来到，就有人告诉他说：“乃尔的儿子阿贝乃尔曾来到君王前，君王放他平安走了。”

text_en: Then Joab went to the king and said, “What have you done? Abner came to you; why did you dismiss him, so that he got away?
text_cn: 约阿布就去见君王说：“你作的是什么事？阿贝乃尔到你这里来，你为什么放他平安走了？

text_en: You know that Abner son of Ner came to deceive you, and to learn your comings and goings and to learn all that you are doing. ”
text_cn: 你岂不认识乃尔的儿子阿贝乃尔？他来是为欺骗你，愿探听你的出入，知道你的一切行动。”

text_en: When Joab came out from David’s presence, he sent messengers after Abner, and they brought him back from the cistern of Sirah; but David did not know about it.
text_cn: 约阿布离开达味，就打发差役去追赶阿贝乃尔。他们从息辣的旱井旁，把他带回来。达味一点也不知道。

text_en: When Abner returned to Hebron, Joab took him aside in the gateway to speak with him privately, and there he stabbed him in the stomach. So he died for shedding the blood of Asahel, Joab’s brother.
text_cn: 阿贝乃尔一回到赫贝龙，约阿布就领他到大门旁，仿佛要与他暗地交谈，就在那里一刀刺穿了他的肚腹，他立即死了；这样替他兄弟阿撒耳报了血仇。

text_en: Afterward, when David heard of it, he said, “I and my kingdom are forever guiltless before the Lord for the blood of Abner son of Ner.
text_cn: 事后，达味一听说这事，就说：“我和我的国家，对乃尔的儿子阿贝乃尔的血案，在上主面前，永远是无罪的！

text_en: May the guilt fall on the head of Joab, and on all his father’s house; and may the house of Joab never be without one who has a discharge, or who is leprous, or who holds a spindle, or who falls by the sword, or who lacks food! ”
text_cn: 愿这罪归在约阿布的头上和他父的全家！愿约阿布家中不断有患淋症，长癞病，只会纺线，丧身刀下和缺粮的人！”

text_en: So Joab and his brother Abishai murdered Abner because he had killed their brother Asahel in the battle at Gibeon.
text_cn: 约阿布和他的兄弟阿彼瑟暗杀了阿贝乃尔，是因为他在基贝红打仗时，杀死了他们的兄弟阿撒耳。

text_en: Then David said to Joab and to all the people who were with him, “Tear your clothes, and put on sackcloth, and mourn over Abner. ” And King David followed the bier.
text_cn: 达味向约阿布和同他在一起的民众说：“要撕裂你们的衣服，穿上丧服，为阿贝乃尔举哀！”达味王也跟在灵柩后送葬。

text_en: They buried Abner at Hebron. The king lifted up his voice and wept at the grave of Abner, and all the people wept.
text_cn: 他们在赫贝龙埋葬了阿贝乃尔；君王在阿贝乃尔墓旁放声大哭，民众也都哭了。

text_en: The king lamented for Abner, saying, “Should Abner die as a fool dies?
text_cn: 君王作哀歌追悼阿贝乃尔说：“阿贝乃尔岂应像傻瓜一样死去？

text_en: Your hands were not bound, your feet were not fettered; as one falls before the wicked you have fallen. ” And all the people wept over him again.
text_cn: 你的手并未束拷，你的脚也没带镣，怎么你毙命，竟如凶犯毙命一样！”为此民众更加痛哭。

text_en: Then all the people came to persuade David to eat something while it was still day; but David swore, saying, “So may God do to me, and more, if I taste bread or anything else before the sun goes down! ”
text_cn: 随后，众人前来劝君王进食，那时还是白天，达味却发誓说：“若我在日落前进食，或尝什么东西，愿天主如此，并加倍地惩罚我！”

text_en: All the people took notice of it, and it pleased them; just as everything the king did pleased all the people.
text_cn: 众人见到此事，都心悦诚服。因为凡君王所行的，无不叫众人心悦诚服。

text_en: So all the people and all Israel understood that day that the king had no part in the killing of Abner son of Ner.
text_cn: 如此，众人和全以色列当天都知道，杀乃尔的儿子阿贝乃尔，不是出于君王的命令。

text_en: And the king said to his servants, “Do you not know that a prince and a great man has fallen this day in Israel?
text_cn: 达味向他的臣仆说：“你们不知道今天在以色列丧失了一位将领和伟人吗？

text_en: Today I am powerless, even though anointed king; these men, the sons of Zeruiah, are too violent for me. The Lord pay back the one who does wickedly in accordance with his wickedness! ”
text_cn: 我今天虽是傅油的君王，仍年幼无力，责鲁雅的儿子们又比我刚强；愿上主依照人所行的邪恶，来施行报复！”
